title: Creative Systems Archive
purpose: Preserve conversation-developed games, simulations, music directions, comedic systems, media experiments and recovered legacy creative arcs as a distinct creative branch rather than mixing them into theology or empirical world data, while also recording what each work is structurally able to model.
principle: Creative works can reuse Potatoverse symbols without automatically becoming doctrinal canon. A work may nevertheless function as a simulation, compression device or experiment that makes a relationship easier to see.

projects.title: Potato of Life Growth Game
projects.core_loop: Grow one potato toward perfection, breed offspring, sell selected potatoes for resources, improve genetics and repeat across generations.
projects.tone: funny Tim/Potato of Life comments and memories integrated into play

projects.title: Tim Dooley Trading Game
projects.relation: Connects Potato humor and market systems thinking without being an economic-data source.

projects.title: Self-Playing AI Potato Town
projects.premise: A self-playing town with God/Tim on a couch, Son at the Door, autonomous agents and accelerated seasons.
projects.time_model: 1 minute of play can represent approximately one month in-world
analytical_value: how small rules generate larger stories

projects.title: Dog House Surveillance Game-Show Fiction
projects.premise: A rich Tim Dooley places chaotic dogs in an empty monitored house while an internet audience votes on increasingly absurd tasks and resource games.
projects.tone: surreal, cruel-comedy parody of livestream/game-show culture; treat as fiction, not real-world instruction

projects.title: Dense Potatoverse Poetry
projects.form: long unbroken symbolic compression, often avoiding periods and conventional pauses
analytical_value: testing which motifs remain coherent when densely coupled

projects.title: Sermon / Comedy / Speech Hybrid
projects.function: Use mythic Potato language, absurdity and institutional critique in a voice that can shift between sermon, rant, comedy and systems analysis.
analytical_value: how humor changes access to difficult material

projects.title: Secret Hidden Esoteric Potato School (Advanced)
projects.type: interactive lore / quest satire / teaching-game concept
projects.source_status: conversation archaeology; original artifact/conversation still to recover
projects.premise: A deliberately ridiculous hidden school where Potato growth, Doors, keys, puzzles and assignments turn philosophy into an initiation-game while simultaneously mocking prestige, tuition and esoteric gatekeeping.
remembered_elements: absurd tuition followed by surprise multiplication/free joke
grow the potato rather than merely consume it

projects.title: The Mashy Arc
projects.source_status: conversation archaeology with separate source-lineage owner

projects.title: The Infinite Potato
projects.premise: A potato whose many eyes can observe multiple or all timelines, turning the ordinary potato eye into an exaggerated witness/possibility device.

projects.title: Reverse Triangulation
projects.source_status: conversation archaeology; original user wording and assistant elaborations need separation
projects.core: Work backward through apparent contradictions or multiple observations toward the hidden center, self or relation capable of accounting for them.
projects.boundary: Do not attribute later assistant-created imagery or jokes to Tim unless the original conversation establishes authorship.

projects.title: Ben Shapirostein and the Ultimate Eyebrow
projects.boundary: Fictional/comedic parody material; not factual biography of any real person.

projects.title: Wall Practice / Carving Sequence
projects.reported_form: A long wall-directed vocal/performance practice described as an ordered symbolic construction sequence.
projects.boundary: Archive as creative/performance history, not as required practice or health guidance.

projects.title: Visual Art & Symbolic Composition Corpus
projects.function: Preserve couch-throne, Door/drain, Heavenly Gardener, red-heifer, dog/Swamp, red-blue Potato, Merkaba/tree-stair and related composition histories as artifacts rather than losing them inside prose canon.

cross_work_patterns.iteration: Growth games and simulations make recurrence visible rather than merely describing it.
cross_work_patterns.compressed_time: Accelerated seasons and generational loops make long-term consequences observable in a short session.
cross_work_patterns.observer_problem: Town, Infinite Potato and surveillance concepts repeatedly ask what changes when an observer can watch a whole system while individual agents remain inside it.
cross_work_patterns.attention_as_mechanism: Trading interfaces, livestream satire and performance forms all model attention as something that selects, amplifies and values events.
cross_work_patterns.symbol_to_system: Creative works provide a place where a symbol such as Door, Potato, Garden or Swamp can be tested as a rule or interaction rather than only interpreted as an image.
cross_work_patterns.threshold_play: Potato School, Mashy Arc, AI Town and visual Door scenes repeatedly turn transition into a playable or performable mechanism.
cross_work_patterns.sacred_absurdity: The project deliberately places sacred language beside potatoes, couches, eyebrows, dogs, walls and game mechanics. The absurdity often functions as an anti-prestige device rather than mere decoration.

culture_propagation_model.archive_use: Creative records should eventually point not only to what was made but to how it moved, was reinterpreted, remixed, remembered or forgotten.

nontent.definition: Presence-centered media in which continuity, waiting, repetition, interaction, atmosphere and accumulated shared history are themselves a substantial part of the medium rather than merely empty space between packaged content objects.
nontent.creative_relation: Livestreaming can therefore be archived as performance ecology and social duration, not only as a list of clips or topics.

music_aesthetics.electronic_reference: dubstep lineage such as Mt Eden is preferred over generic trap when looking for heavy emotional bass music
music_aesthetics.composition_preferences: Natural cadence matters; forced or obvious rhyme is disliked. Rhythm, narrative pressure and tonal coherence should lead the writing.

archive_rule: Keep prototypes, specifications, lyrics/prompts, visual concepts and finished works linked by project ID so creative evolution can be reconstructed later.
separation_rule: MYTH may inspire WORK, but WORK does not automatically become MYTH or evidence. Simulation results describe the rules of the simulation unless separately validated against the world.
